linkedin:
Same sites, separate sign-ins.

In S3 Browser each space can keep its own sign-ins, so your General and Work spaces use different accounts side by side in one window. Mail, calendar and docs from two companies, without signing out and back in.

Three spaces sit as chips in the top bar; one click switches. You can turn separate sign-ins on in the New Space form, in a space's menu or at the top of the editor. Turning it off tells you the space's accounts are removed. They are never mixed.

It also matters for AI agents: an agent can work inside the sign-ins of the space you choose, without touching your window.

Free for Macs with Apple silicon.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-browser
